page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor with an x86_64 architecture and a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It does not contain any GPU accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfr8i.4xlarge is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It is suitable for hosting relational databases, in-memory caches, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention.
